summary: Completed Module 10 CONTEXT micro-exercise: articulated container networking requirements, host binding to 0.0.0.0, and dynamic platform port injection with fallback.
evidence: Identified failure mode of binding to localhost (127.0.0.1): external proxy traffic from Railway is unable to bridge the container boundary, leading to connection timeouts and deploy failure.
Identified failure mode of hardcoding ports: cloud platforms inject dynamic PORT environment variables, causing proxy mismatches when port numbers diverge.

Formulated production-ready startup command: 'uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}', ensuring universal network interface binding and dynamic port configuration with local development fallback.
